response.original_title: One Early Morning, the Alligator Swallowed Me
response.overview: The northern Colombian town of Plato is known for the legend of the Alligator Man, who could change shape and use his disguise to spy unnoticed on women in the river. There is even a museum dedicated to him. This confident student film breathes new life into the local folklore through an enigmatic portrait of a solitary fisherman. He is filmed on the river and in the wetlands, with an emphasis on the beauty of the surroundings.
response.title: One Early Morning, the Alligator Swallowed Me
